basic_details.job_title: Zila Panchayat Bemetara Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 4 Accountant, Programme Officer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: District Panchayat (Zila Panchayat) Bemetara (जिला पंचायत बेमेतरा), Chhattisgarh, is filling 4 contract posts at Janpad level under VB-G RAM G. The posts are 1 Programme Officer, 1 Assistant Programmer and 2 Accountant. Applications must be sent only by Registered Post or Speed Post to the Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat Bemetara, and must be received by 05 November 2026, 5:30 PM.

content_sections.heading: About Zila Panchayat Bemetara
content_sections.text: Zila Panchayat Bemetara is the district panchayat of Bemetara district in Chhattisgarh. This recruitment fills vacant contract posts at Janpad level under the Viksit Bharat-Rozgar evam Ajeevika ke liye Guarantee Mission (Gramin) (VB-G RAM G). The recruitment follows instructions from the Panchayat and Rural Development Department, Government of Chhattisgarh, and from the Commissioner, VB-G RAM G, Nava Raipur, Atal Nagar.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the complete application to this address: Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat Bemetara, District Bemetara (C.G.), PIN Code 491335 Postal mode: Registered Post or Speed Post only. Applications sent by any other mode will not be accepted. Applications received after 05 November 2026, 5:30 PM will not be accepted, so the application must reach the office by then. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All 4 posts are contract (संविदा) posts at Janpad level. The posts and their reservation are given below. "मुक्त" means the post is not horizontally reserved within its category. One of the 2 Accountant posts is reserved for Scheduled Tribe candidates. All the other posts are unreserved. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. It asks applicants to enclose proof of their educational qualification, experience and other required qualifications, but it does not print what these are for any post. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Copies of certificates of educational qualification Copies of experience certificates Copies of certificates of other required qualifications Latest self-signed photograph Enclosing these is compulsory.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Zila Panchayat Bemetara Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 contract posts: 1 Programme Officer, 1 Assistant Programmer and 2 Accountant.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for Zila Panchayat Bemetara Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 05 November 2026, 5:30 PM. Applications received after that time will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Zila Panchayat Bemetara Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed application format and send it by Registered Post or Speed Post to the Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat Bemetara, District Bemetara (C.G.), PIN Code 491335.

faq.question: Q4. Can I submit the Zila Panchayat Bemetara application by any other mode?
faq.answer: No. Only Registered Post or Speed Post is allowed. Applications sent by any other mode will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q5. Which documents must be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: You must enclose copies of your certificates of educational qualification, experience and other required qualifications, along with a latest self-signed photograph.

faq.question: Q6. Is any post reserved for Scheduled Tribe candidates?
faq.answer: Yes. One of the 2 Accountant posts is reserved for ST (मुक्त). The other Accountant post, the Programme Officer post and the Assistant Programmer post are UR (मुक्त).

faq.question: Q7. Are the Zila Panchayat Bemetara posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. All 4 posts are contract (संविदा) posts at Janpad level under VB-G RAM G.
